# Manzel Studio

> Manzel Studio is a Melbourne-based building design studio creating thoughtful, functional, and inspiring spaces for residential, commercial, and health-space projects across Victoria, Australia.

Manzel Studio provides building design, drafting, and permit documentation services, guiding clients from initial concept through council approval and construction support. The studio is a registered building design practice based in Preston, Victoria.

## Services

- [Residential Building Design](https://www.manzelstudio.com.au/residential-building-design): Custom homes, extensions, townhouses, and dual occupancy design across Victoria.
- [Commercial Building Design](https://www.manzelstudio.com.au/commercial-building-design): Offices, retail fit-outs, hospitality, and mixed-use developments.
- [Health Space Design](https://www.manzelstudio.com.au/health-space-design): Registered building design for medical clinics, aged care, and NDIS facilities.
- [Site Assessment](https://www.manzelstudio.com.au/site-assessment): Zoning, overlay, and development-potential reviews for a property, from $198.
